name: Forced displacement
summary: UNHCR counts up to 50,000 who fled Ethiopia's Moyale clashes into Kenya; no UN-confirmed event over 500,000 a month
state: UNHCR said up to 50,000 people had crossed from Ethiopia into Kenya after clashes in Moyale from late October, up from 36,000 earlier, with registration ongoing (Africanews, 10 Nov; Nation). A higher NGO estimate of internal displacement has not been confirmed by UNHCR or IOM. Searches on 20 Nov found no UN-confirmed new event reaching 500,000 in a month, so the signal stays Normal.
for_you: Cross-border flows at this scale strain local services in northern Kenya and drive UN funding appeals; they rarely affect travel or prices elsewhere.
rubric_hit: Normal: largest new UN-confirmed displacement found (Moyale, up to 50,000) is below the 500,000-in-a-month Watch line

why: Over 120 million people are forcibly displaced; new mass displacement drives regional instability and migration politics.
